title: Setup 1: choose factions
text: Players decide who plays the Empire and who plays the Rebels (randomly if they cannot agree), and each takes his faction's miniatures, leaders, loyalty markers, faction sheet, mission cards and action cards.

title: Setup 3: board and time track
text: The two board halves are put together; the time marker goes on space 1 of the time track and the reputation marker on space 14.

title: Setup 4-7: decks
text: Objectives: shuffle stages I, II and III separately and stack III, II, I (top); the Rebels draw one. Each player shuffles his action cards with a recruit icon into an action deck. Shuffle both tactic decks. Missions: set aside the four starting missions, the Empire shuffles the projects onto the board, and each player shuffles the rest into his mission deck.

title: Standard setup 8.I: starting loyalty
text: Reveal probe cards until three Rebel and five Imperial systems are shown. Each Rebel system gets a Rebel loyalty marker; the first two Imperial systems get subjugation markers and the other three Imperial loyalty markers. The five Imperial probe cards go back to the box; the rest are shuffled back into the probe deck.

title: Standard setup 8.II: Imperial starting units
text: The Empire gets 3 Star Destroyers, 3 Assault Carriers, 12 TIE Fighters, 12 Stormtroopers, 5 AT-STs, 1 AT-AT and 1 Death Star and places them in systems with an Imperial loyalty or subjugation marker, with at least one ground unit in each Imperial system.

title: Standard setup 8.III: Rebel starting units
text: The Rebels get 1 Corellian Corvette, 1 Rebel Transport, 2 X-wings, 2 Y-wings, 6 Rebel Troopers and 2 Airspeeders and place them on the "Rebel Base" space and/or in one single other system (the RR says a Rebel or neutral system; see the errata).

title: Rebel starting units: any one system without Imperial units (errata)
text: Following the Neutral Systems erratum, the Rebel starting units go on the "Rebel Base" space and/or any one system that contains no Imperial units.

title: Standard setup 8.IV: starting action cards
text: Each player draws two random starting action cards (those without a recruit icon) and keeps them facedown; the other starting action cards return to the box unrevealed. In the first game no starting action cards are used.

title: Setup 9: choose the base location
text: The Rebel player secretly chooses one card from the probe deck and places it facedown under the "Location" space; then the probe deck is shuffled and put on its board space.

title: Base choice: no system with Imperial units
text: Before choosing, the Rebel player makes sure the probe cards of all systems containing Imperial units have been removed from the deck. In the first game he also picks a system that is not adjacent to any Imperial unit.

title: Setup 10: starting hand
text: Each player takes his four starting missions and draws two cards from his mission deck; this hand is kept secret.

title: First game setup versus standard setup
text: For the first game, starting units and loyalty follow the fixed diagram of the Learn to Play booklet; for later games step 8 is the variable advanced setup, which the Rules Reference setup appendix includes.

title: First game setup: Rebels and probe deck
text: Remove the probe cards of Corellia, Mandalore, Saleucami, Sullust and Mustafar. Rebel loyalty: Kashyyyk, Bothawui, Naboo. Bothawui: 1 Corellian Corvette, 1 Rebel Transport, 1 X-wing, 1 Y-wing, 3 Rebel Troopers, 1 Airspeeder. "Rebel Base" space: 1 X-wing, 1 Y-wing, 3 Rebel Troopers, 1 Airspeeder.

title: First game setup: Empire
text: Saleucami (Imperial loyalty): SD, 2 TIE, 2 Stormtroopers, AT-ST. Mandalore (subjugated): Death Star, 4 TIE, 2 Stormtroopers, AT-ST. Coruscant: SD, Assault Carrier, 2 TIE, 3 Stormtroopers, AT-AT, AT-ST. Corellia (Imperial loyalty): Assault Carrier, Stormtrooper. Sullust (subjugated): SD, 2 TIE, 2 Stormtroopers, AT-ST. Mustafar (Imperial loyalty): Assault Carrier, 2 TIE, 2 Stormtroopers, AT-ST.

title: Imperial starting units may be placed on Coruscant
text: In the standard setup the Empire may place starting units on Coruscant, although it receives no loyalty marker.
rationale: RR p.15 allows systems with an Imperial loyalty or subjugation marker; Coruscant has no marker but is permanently loyal to the Empire (RR p.8), and the first game diagram puts Imperial units there (LTP p.16). Not stated explicitly for the standard setup.
